title: Google is in talks for a $1.5 billion-plus deal with AI coding agent startup Mechanize
byline: Katie Roof, Ben Bergman, Charles Rollet, Hugh Langley
excerpt: Google wants its AI to get better at coding. It might have found a shortcut with the startup Mechanize.

Google wants its AI to get better at coding. It might have found a shortcut.

The tech giant has been in discussions with San Francisco startup Mechanize in recent weeks for a potential deal that would involve Google hiring some of Mechanize's talent, four people familiar with the conversations said.

The deal, which some of the people said is worth over $1.5 billion, is in progress, and details could change. Google is discussing a non-exclusive licensing agreement for Mechanize's technology as part of the deal, one person familiar with the matter said. The talent Google could acquire from Mechanize would work on model evaluation and development, the person added.

The talks highlight two realities of the AI boom. Coding has become one of the most important — and lucrative — applications of AI, and Big Tech companies are getting creative about how they acquire the talent and technology they need to stay competitive.

It wouldn't be the first time Google has done a workaround deal for talent and technology. In the past couple of years, Google has structured acquisitions as hybrid transactions that include bringing in talent via acquihires and gathering technology through licensing and other methods. Companies sometimes take this approach to avoid the antitrust scrutiny of full acquisitions.

Last year, Google swept in to acquire Windsurf's talent and licensed its tech after OpenAI tried to buy it. Windsurf's CEO, Varun Mohan, now leads Google's Antigravity, an agentic coding platform. In 2024, the search giant rehired Character AI cofounder Noam Shazeer and paid for non-exclusive rights to use the startup's AI technology (Shazeer recently left the company to join OpenAI).

Google declined to comment over email. Mechanize declined to comment.

Mechanize launched last year with a mission of automating every job and a star-studded group of investors, including former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman, Stripe CEO Patrick Collison, and podcaster Dwarkesh Patel.

The startup said earlier this year that it raised $9.1 million in a funding round at a $500 million valuation. Mechanize's CEO, Tamay Besiroglu, previously cofounded Epoch AI, which also focused on testing AI models.

Mechanize's tech can help tech companies improve the performance of their AI models at coding — something Google has struggled with, while OpenAI and Anthropic have scooped up developer customers with Codex and Claude Code.

Mechanize has wider ambitions than coding. "Our current focus is software engineering, but our long-term goal is the full automation of valuable work across the economy," its website reads.

独家的

作者：Katie Roof 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 , Ben Bergman 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 , Charles Rollet 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。和休·兰利（Hugh Langley）您目前正在关注这位作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

谷歌希望其人工智能能够更好地编码。 它可能找到了一条捷径。

四位知情人士表示，这家科技巨头最近几周一直在与旧金山初创公司 Mechanize 就一项潜在交易进行讨论，其中涉及谷歌聘用 Mechanize 的部分人才。

一些知情人士称，这笔交易价值超过 15 亿美元，目前正在进行中，细节可能会发生变化。 一位知情人士表示，作为交易的一部分，谷歌正在讨论一项 Mechanize 技术的非独家许可协议。 该人士补充说，谷歌可以从 Mechanize 获得的人才将致力于模型评估和开发。

会谈强调了人工智能热潮的两个现实。 编码已成为人工智能最重要且最有利可图的应用之一，大型科技公司在如何获取保持竞争力所需的人才和技术方面正在发挥创意。

这并不是谷歌第一次针对人才和技术进行变通交易。 在过去几年中，谷歌将收购构建为混合交易，包括通过收购引进人才以及通过许可和其他方法收集技术。 公司有时会采取这种方法来避免全面收购的反垄断审查。

去年，在 OpenAI 试图收购 Windsurf 后，谷歌收购了 Windsurf 的人才并授权其技术。 Windsurf 的首席执行官 Varun Mohan 现在领导着 Google 的 Antigravity，这是一个代理编码平台。 2024年，这家搜索巨头重新聘请了Character AI联合创始人Noam Shazeer，并支付了使用该初创公司AI技术的非独家权利（Shazeer最近离开公司加入OpenAI）。

谷歌拒绝通过电子邮件发表评论。 机械化拒绝置评。

Mechanize 去年推出，其使命是让每项工作实现自动化，并拥有一群明星云集的投资者，其中包括前 GitHub 首席执行官 Nat Friedman、Stripe 首席执行官 Patrick Collison 和播客 Dwarkesh Patel。

该初创公司今年早些时候表示，在一轮融资中筹集了 910 万美元，估值为 5 亿美元。 Mechanize 的首席执行官 Tamay Besiroglu 之前是 Epoch AI 的联合创始人，该公司也专注于测试人工智能模型。

Mechanize 的技术可以帮助科技公司提高人工智能模型在编码方面的性能——这是谷歌一直在努力解决的问题，而 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 则通过 Codex 和 Claude Code 赢得了开发者客户。

机械化比编码有着更广阔的野心。 “我们目前的重点是软件工程，但我们的长期目标是整个经济中有价值的工作完全自动化，”其网站上写道。
